new_findings.finding: The source uses close, but transferable causal descendants may compute the same EMA geometry on other causal bar-price transforms. The ontology freezes quote side but not OHLC price transform.
new_findings.required_fix: Enumerate CLOSE, HL2, HLC3 and OHLC4 as preregistered feature transforms.

new_findings.finding: ATR is used both for pullback distance and discovery management, but period and smoothing are not frozen as dimensions.
new_findings.required_fix: Enumerate ATR period and causal smoothing families; keep source default SMA(14) explicitly represented.

new_findings.finding: Slope-based HTF/LTF regime families are listed without a slope lookback definition.
new_findings.required_fix: Enumerate slope lookback in closed bars and define sign as value[t]-value[t-k].

new_findings.finding: A one-bar EMA ordering and a persistent ordering are causally distinct implementations of the same regime thesis.
new_findings.required_fix: Enumerate minimum consecutive closed HTF bars satisfying regime.

new_findings.finding: Pullback event depth is frozen but event duration and recovery overshoot beyond the EMA are not.
new_findings.required_fix: Enumerate maximum pullback duration and recovery overshoot in ATR units.

new_findings.finding: First executable quote is the primary rule, but latency stress belongs to validation and should not silently alter discovery identity.
new_findings.required_fix: Freeze discovery latency to first executable quote; preregister latency as validation stress only.
